records.jp: 詩帆の心の中に入れた。<CR>どうやら、かなり異灰化しているようだ
records.en_original: I'm inside Shiho's mind now. It looks like she's pretty deeply tainted by the Testa.
records.en: I'm inside Shiho's mind now.<CR>It looks like she's pretty deeply tainted by the Testa.

records.jp: へぇ、ビックリ。<CR>まさか、こんな所にお客さんが来るなんて
records.en_original: Whoa, what a surprise! Didn't expect to have visitors here.
records.en: Whoa, what a surprise!<CR>Didn't expect to have visitors here.

records.jp: こんにちは～♪<CR>そんなに警戒しないでくださいよー
records.en_original: Hi there! No need to be so on guard, okay?
records.en: Hi there!<CR>No need to be so on guard, okay?

records.jp: 私の名前は詩。駒川詩で～す
records.en_original: My name's Uta. Uta Komagawa!
records.en: My name's Uta. Komagawa Uta!

records.jp: ここに来られるということは、<CR>あなたイローデッドなんだ
records.en_original: If you made it here, that means you're an Eroded too.
records.en: If you made it here, that means<CR>you're an Eroded too.

records.jp: どんな能力を持ってるんですかー？
records.en_original: So, what kind of abilities do you have?
records.en: So, what kind of abilities do you have?

records.jp: あらら、随分と警戒されてるみたいですね
records.en_original: Oh wow, you're super cautious, aren't you?
records.en: Oh wow, you're super cautious, aren't you?

records.jp: もしかして、私がこの子を苦しめてる、<CR>とか思っちゃったりしてますー？
records.en_original: Could it be that you think I'm the one tormenting this girl?
records.en: Could it be that you think I'm<CR>the one tormenting this girl?

records.jp: 「だとしたら、すぐに出て行ってもらう」
records.en_original: If that's the case, I want you out of here immediately.
records.en: If that's the case, I want you out of here immediately.

records.jp: へぇ、殺さないなんて優しいんですね♪
records.en_original: Wow, that's so nice of you not to kill me.
records.en: Wow, that's so nice of you not to kill me.

records.jp: でも私としては～、もうちょっと私のこと<CR>痛めつけてくれる人の方が好みかな～なんて――
records.en_original: But, honestly, I kinda prefer people who rough me up a bit, you know...
records.en: But, honestly, I kinda prefer<CR>people who rough me up a bit, you know...

records.jp: 答えはイエス。……だったら楽しいことに<CR>なりそうだけど、残念ながらノー。私はただの観客
records.en_original: The answer's yes... I wish I could say that—this might've gone somewhere fun, but too bad—nope! I'm just an observer.
records.en: The answer's yes... I wish I could say that—this might've gone somewhere fun,<CR>but too bad—nope! I'm just an observer.

records.jp: この子の心の中には、<CR>このシマのクイーンが入り込んでるんですよ
records.en_original: The Queen of this zone is hiding inside her heart, you know.
records.en: The Queen of this zone<CR>is hiding inside her heart, you know.

records.jp: 見たいですか？　ほらっ
records.en_original: Wanna see? Here you go!
records.en: Wanna see? Here you go!

records.jp: “彼女”、イローデッドの身体を使って活動したい<CR>みたいなんですよね。だから今は身体が無いんですよ
records.en_original: She wants to operate using an Eroded's body. That's why she doesn't have a body right now.
records.en: She wants to operate using an Eroded's body.<CR>That's why she doesn't have a body right now.

records.jp: “クイーン”って呼ばれる異灰には、そういう子が<CR>多いみたいなんです。なぜなんでしょうね？？
records.en_original: A lot of those Testa called "Queens" are like that, it seems. I wonder why?
records.en: A lot of those Testa called "Queens" are like that, it seems.<CR>I wonder why?

records.jp: 「やけにクイーンに詳しいが、異灰の眷属なのか？」
records.en_original: You know a lot about Queens. Do you work for the Testa?
records.en: You know a lot about Queens. Do you work for the Testa?

records.jp: ひどーい。むしろ“彼女”が隠れてたのを、<CR>私が暴いてあげたのに。ご褒美が欲しいくらいです
records.en_original: That's so mean! I just told you where the Queen is hiding—you should be thanking me!
records.en: That's so mean!<CR>I just told you where the Queen is hiding—you should be thanking me!

records.jp: あっ、それと、安心してくださいね？　<CR>後ろの“彼女”、心の中だと微動だにできませんから
records.en_original: Oh, and don't worry, okay? "She" can't move at all inside this heart.
records.en: Oh, and don't worry, okay?<CR>"She" can't move at all inside this heart.

records.jp: どうして“彼女”がこの子の中にいるのか、<CR>気になってます？
records.en_original: Are you curious why the Queen is inside this girl?
records.en: Are you curious why the Queen is inside<CR>this girl?

records.jp: やっぱり、心に隙があったからだと思いますよ？<CR>放心してたとか、無気力状態だったとか
records.en_original: I bet it's because there was an opening in her heart. Like maybe she was dazed, or just totally out of it.
records.en: I bet it's because there was an opening in her heart.<CR>Like maybe she was dazed, or just totally out of it.

records.jp: ん？　おい、詩帆。<CR>ボーッとしているようだが平気なのか？
records.en_original: Hm? Hey, Shiho. You seem kinda spaced out. Are you all right?
records.en: Hm? Hey, Shiho.<CR>You seem kinda spaced out. Are you all right?

records.jp: ね？　心当たりありますよね？
records.en_original: See? You've got a clue, don't you?
records.en: See? You've got a clue, don't you?

records.jp: 「駒川さんも不法侵入に変わりない。出ていけ」
records.en_original: You're trespassing too, Uta. Get out.
records.en: You're trespassing too, Komagawa-san. Get out.

records.jp: わあっ、怖い～～♪　<CR>さっきの恩忘れちゃったんですか～？
records.en_original: Oh no, you're so scary! Already forgotten the favor I just did for you?
records.en: Oh no, you're so scary!<CR>Already forgotten the favor I just did for you?

records.jp: それに赤の他人の心の中――エーテル空間で<CR>フツーの人間が私に干渉できるわけないですし
records.en_original: Anyway, there's no way some regular person could interfere with me in someone else's Ether Space.
records.en: Anyway, there's no way some regular person<CR>could interfere with me in someone else's Ether Space.

records.jp: 私のことは放っておいた方が、<CR>あなたのためだと思いますよー
records.en_original: I'd say it's better for you if you just leave me alone.
records.en: I'd say it's better for you<CR>if you just leave me alone.

records.jp: 痛ーっ！
records.en_original: Ouch!
records.en: Ouch!

records.jp: うそっ、エーテル空間で傷モノにされちゃうなんてっ！<CR>超コーフンするんですけど～ぉ！
records.en_original: No way, getting hurt inside the Ether Space?! This is seriously exciting!
records.en: No way, getting hurt inside the Ether Space?!<CR>This is seriously exciting!

records.jp: なるほどね。“エーテルフェログラム”
records.en_original: I see. "Ether Pherogram," huh?
records.en: I see. "Ether Pherogram," huh?

records.jp: 昔、近くにいたんですよね～、<CR>その力を持ってるイローデッドの子が
records.en_original: There used to be an Eroded with that power nearby, you know.
records.en: There used to be an Eroded<CR>with that power nearby, you know.

records.jp: 正直言うと、その力は嫌いなんですよね
records.en_original: Honestly? I kind of hate that power.
records.en: Honestly? I kind of hate that power.

records.jp: でも、あなたには興味大アリです♡
records.en_original: But you, on the other hand... I'm totally interested in you.
records.en: But you, on the other hand... I'm totally interested in you.

records.jp: だから、ここで嫌われるのはイヤかなって<CR>思うんでぇ――
records.en_original: So, I'd rather not get on your bad side right now.
records.en: So, I'd rather not get on your bad side<CR>right now.

records.jp: 今回は素直に引くことにしますね。<CR>本当はもっと痛めつけてほしかったですけど♪
records.en_original: I'll back off for now, okay? Though, I really wanted you to rough me up a teensy bit more.
records.en: I'll back off for now, okay?<CR>Though, I really wanted you to rough me up a teensy bit more.

records.jp: それはまた、今度のお楽しみ♪　ということで！
records.en_original: We can save that for next time. Deal?
records.en: We can save that for next time. Deal?

records.jp: 「今度とはどういう意味だ？」
records.en_original: What do you mean, "next time"?
records.en: What do you mean, "next time"?

records.jp: 早くクイーンを追い出した方がいいですよ。<CR>それじゃ――
records.en_original: You should hurry and drive out the Queen. See ya!
records.en: You should hurry and drive out the Queen.<CR>See ya!

records.jp: 駒川詩は逃げたようだ。<CR>しかし、何が目的だったのだろう……
records.en_original: Looks like she ran away. What was she really after?
records.en: Looks like she ran away.<CR>What was she really after?

records.jp: あっ、お兄ちゃんが起きた！！<CR>無事でよかったよー
records.en_original: Ah! Big brother woke up! Thank goodness you're okay!
records.en: Ah! Onii-chan woke up!<CR>Thank goodness you're okay!

records.jp: 戻ってきたか。<CR>無事に“引っ張り出せた”ようだな
records.en_original: You're back. Looks like you managed to extract safely.
records.en: You're back.<CR>Looks like you managed to extract safely.

records.jp: ねえ、このデカいの詩帆から出てきたんだけど、<CR>こいつまさか……
records.en_original: Hey, this huge thing came out of Shiho—don't tell me it's...
records.en: Hey, this huge thing came out of Shiho—don't<CR>tell me it's...

records.jp: 「これより、クイーン討伐作戦を開始する！」
records.en_original: From here on out, our Queen extermination mission begins!
records.en: From here on out, our Queen extermination mission begins!

records.jp: はぁ～、やっぱりクイーンだったか。<CR>この前は上手く倒せたけど……
records.en_original: *Groan* So it really was a Queen. We managed to beat one without too much trouble last time, but...
records.en: *Groan* So it really was a Queen.<CR>We managed to beat one without too much trouble last time, but...

records.jp: 協力して戦えば、絶対勝てるよ。<CR>リーダーもいるんだし
records.en_original: If we all work together, we'll definitely win. I mean, we have Leader with us.
records.en: If we all work together, we'll definitely win.<CR>I mean, we have Leader with us.

records.jp: かんなたちだっているんだからね。<CR>よーし、頑張っちゃうぞー！
records.en_original: We're here too, you know! All right, I'm really gonna give it my all!
records.en: We're here too, you know! All right,<CR>I'm really gonna give it my all!

records.jp: お喋りは終わりだ。<CR>みんな、行くぞ！
records.en_original: Enough chit-chat. Let's go, everyone!
records.en: Enough chit-chat.<CR>Let's go, everyone!

records.jp: ……了解
records.en_original: ...Understood.
records.en: ...Understood.
